_comment: The topics the research sweep reads. The operator chose them, and this file
is their only home: change them here, in the repo, not in the installed
workspace, or the next `npm run install:local` writes them back.
WHY JSON AND NOT YAML: this file is read with `JSON.parse` at module load,
with no dependency and no parser of our own. YAML would need one, and an
extension may not bundle a native module or grow a dependency the host does
not already carry.
WHAT EACH FIELD MEANS:
key         the topic's identifier. It is what `researchSweep` accepts in
its `topics` argument and what each candidate carries back as
`topic`. It never appears in a fetched URL.
hu          what the agent calls the topic when it talks to the operator.
query       what is actually searched. IN ENGLISH: Reddit, Hacker News and
GitHub speak English, and a Hungarian search returns nothing.
subreddits  the subreddits `fetchReddit` searches, one request each. A
comma-separated list; the fetcher also accepts an array. Without
them the search is a general keyword sweep, and general keyword
sweeps are exactly what makes these small-business topics noisy.
search      carried over from the Hermes research runner this file came
from, where it named which of that tool's sources to ask. This
extension does NOT read it: it always asks Reddit, Hacker News
and GitHub, and reports by name any of the three that did not
answer, so a run can never imply it looked somewhere it did not.
THE KEYWORD TRAP -- MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. The first `skillek` query
("useful MCP servers ... worth using") pulled "Useful Bash Tricks" and "Awe
does not require PAE, though PAE makes it more useful" off Hacker News: the
search matched the common adjective (`useful`), not the subject. So a query
is built from CONCRETE NOUNS (MCP server, Claude Code, agent skill), never
from general adjectives.

topics.query: small business AI automation what actually works customer support admin
small business automation stack tools we stopped using what broke migration away
MCP server Claude Code agent skill workflow setup experience
